note: SBAs are checked throughout the game, not by a player

outcome: State-based actions are checked and performed simultaneously whenever a player would get priority, repeating until none apply, before triggers go on the stack.
A state-based check ignores temporary states in the middle of a resolution, so a creature with transient 0 toughness mid-resolution survives if it is fine when resolution ends.
A player at 0 or less life loses the game in the next state-based check.
A player who attempted to draw from an empty library loses the game in the next state-based check.
A player with ten or more poison counters loses the game in the next state-based check.
A token in a zone other than the battlefield ceases to exist.
A spell copy outside the stack, or a card copy outside the stack or battlefield, ceases to exist.
A creature with toughness 0 or less is put into its owner's graveyard, and regeneration cannot replace it.
A creature with damage marked at least equal to its positive toughness is destroyed, and regeneration can replace it.
A creature dealt damage by a deathtouch source since the last check is destroyed, and regeneration can replace it.
A planeswalker with loyalty 0 is put into its owner's graveyard.
When a player controls two or more legendary permanents with the same name, all but one go to their owners' graveyards.
note: the choice of which to keep is a decision; the outcome is observable

outcome: With two or more world permanents, all but the newest go to graveyards; on a timestamp tie all go.
An Aura attached to an illegal object or player, or to nothing, is put into its owner's graveyard.
An Equipment or Fortification attached to an illegal permanent or a player becomes unattached and stays on the battlefield.
A battle or creature that is attached, or a non-Aura non-Equipment non-Fortification permanent that is attached, becomes unattached and stays on the battlefield.
A permanent with both +1/+1 and -1/-1 counters has N of each removed, N being the smaller count.
A permanent with more counters of a kind than its cap allows loses the excess counters.
A Saga whose lore counters reach its final chapter number, with no chapter ability of its own on the stack, is sacrificed.
A dungeon whose venture marker is on its bottommost room, with no room ability of its own on the stack, is removed from the game.
note: dungeon state is not a field of any record
space sculptor and sector designations are Un-set/Alchemy-style content outside Forge two-player collection

outcome: A Siege battle with defense 0 and no triggered ability of its own on the stack is put into its owner's graveyard.
A non-Siege battle with defense 0 is put into its owner's graveyard.
A battle with no protector and no attackers is given a protector, or goes to the graveyard if none can be chosen.
note: protector choice is a decision; outcome observable

outcome: A battle whose protector can't be its protector gets a new protector, or goes to the graveyard if none can be chosen.
note: protector choice is a decision; the new protector shows in which players' creatures may attack the battle

outcome: When a permanent has several Roles controlled by one player, all but the most recent-timestamp Role go to graveyards.
A player who controls a permanent with start your engines! and has no speed gets speed 1.
note: speed is not a field of any record

outcome: When several state-based actions would have the same result at once, a single replacement effect replaces all of them.
A permanent leaving the battlefield through an SBA has last known information taken from the state before any of that check's SBAs, which decides triggers such as undying.
